question: Explain the concept of object-oriented programming and its four pillars.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: OOP organizes code into objects. The four pillars: encapsulation (bundling data and methods), inheritance (reusing code), polymorphism (different implementations of same interface), and abstraction (hiding complexity). In my project, I created a base User class with Admin and Customer subclasses, demonstrating inheritance and polymorphism.
